description: This file defines the main application model 'NodeAppModel' for an iOS app, managing UI interactions, gateway connections, device capabilities, notifications, and various system services within the app. It includes class properties, initialization, scene phase management, command handling, and integrations with camera, location, notifications, and network services.

classes.name: NotificationCallError
classes.description: Error type wrapping notification call failures, non-Sendable

classes.name: GatewayRelayIdentityResponse
classes.description: Decodable structure for relay identity responses

classes.name: NotificationInvokeLatch
classes.description: Coordinates async notification calls with timeout and continuation handling

methods.name: setScenePhase
methods.description: Handles changes in app's scene phase, managing background state, reconnections, and resource cleanup

methods.name: beginBackgroundConnectionGracePeriod
methods.description: Starts a background grace period to keep gateway connections alive

methods.name: endBackgroundConnectionGracePeriod
methods.description: Ends the background connection grace period, cancelling associated timers

methods.name: grantBackgroundReconnectLease
methods.description: Acquires a lease to allow background reconnection attempts for a period

methods.name: suppressBackgroundReconnect
methods.description: Suppresses background reconnect attempts and optionally disconnects gateways

methods.name: clearBackgroundReconnectSuppression
methods.description: Clears suppression on background reconnect attempts

methods.name: setVoiceWakeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice wake feature, considering interaction with 'talk' mode

methods.name: setTalkEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables 'talk' mode, updating preferences and notifying gateway

methods.name: requestLocationPermissions
methods.description: Requests location permissions based on supplied mode

methods.name: refreshBrandingFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches branding configuration from the gateway

methods.name: refreshAgentsFromGateway
methods.description: Retrieves list of agents from gateway and updates internal state

methods.name: refreshGatewayOverviewIfConnected
methods.description: Updates branding and agent list if operator is connected

methods.name: setSelectedAgentId
methods.description: Sets the selected agent ID, updating configuration and home canvas revision

methods.name: setGlobalWakeWords
methods.description: Sets global wake words via gateway request

methods.name: startVoiceWakeSync
methods.description: Begins sync loop for voice wake triggers and talk mode updates

methods.name: applyTalkModeSync
methods.description: Synchronizes local talk mode setting with gateway

methods.name: pushTalkModeToGateway
methods.description: Updates remote gateway with current talk mode state

methods.name: startGatewayHealthMonitor
methods.description: Starts periodic health check for gateway connection

methods.name: stopGatewayHealthMonitor
methods.description: Stops the gateway health monitoring

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Handles incoming invocation requests, dispatching to appropriate handlers

methods.name: isBackgroundRestricted
methods.description: Determines if a command is restricted in background mode

methods.name: handleLocationInvoke
methods.description: Handles location-related requests, fetching current location

methods.name: handleCanvasInvoke
methods.description: Handles canvas-related commands: presentation, navigation, eval, snapshot

methods.name: handleCanvasA2UIInvoke
methods.description: Handles A2UI-specific canvas invocation commands

methods.name: handleCameraInvoke
methods.description: Manages camera device listing, photo snapping, and video clipping

methods.name: handleScreenRecordInvoke
methods.description: Manages starting and returning from screen recording

methods.name: handleSystemNotify
methods.description: Triggers local notifications based on parameters

methods.name: handleChatPushInvoke
methods.description: Handles push notifications and optional speech of chat messages

methods.name: requestNotificationAuthorizationIfNeeded
methods.description: Requests notification permission if not already granted

methods.name: notificationAuthorizationStatus
methods.description: Queries current notification permission status

methods.name: runNotificationCall
methods.description: Executes notification-related async operations with timeout and error handling

methods.name: locationMode
methods.description: Returns current location mode setting

methods.name: isLocationPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if precise location is enabled

methods.name: decodeParams
methods.description: Decodes JSON string into a Decodable type, throws if invalid

methods.name: encodePayload
methods.description: Encodes an Encodable object into a JSON string

methods.name: isCameraEnabled
methods.description: Checks if camera is enabled in user defaults, defaulting to enabled

methods.name: triggerCameraFlash
methods.description: Triggers a camera flash event (increments nonce)

methods.name: showCameraHUD
methods.description: Displays a camera HUD with animated appearance and optional auto-hide

methods.name: refreshWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches wake words triggers from the gateway and updates local preferences. Implements error handling for unauthorized access.

methods.name: isGatewayHealthMonitorDisabled
methods.description: Checks whether the gateway health monitor is disabled.

methods.name: setGatewayHealthMonitorDisabled
methods.description: Sets the disabled status of the gateway health monitor.

methods.name: sendVoiceTranscript
methods.description: Sends transcribed voice text to the gateway within an active session, encoding payload as JSON.

methods.name: handleDeepLink
methods.description: Parses and processes deep link URLs, handling different route types and validating message size, gateway connection, and authorization.

methods.name: handleAgentDeepLink
methods.description: Processes agent deep links, checks message size, gateway connection, and user permissions, prompts for confirmation if necessary.

methods.name: sendAgentRequest
methods.description: Sends an agent request deep link payload to the gateway after encoding as JSON.

methods.name: isGatewayConnected
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if the gateway is currently connected.

methods.name: applyMainSessionKey
methods.description: Updates the main session key used for voice interactions, trimming whitespace and avoiding setting if unchanged.

methods.name: color(fromHex:)
methods.description: Creates a Color object from a hexadecimal string, handling optional and invalid formats.

methods.name: approvePendingAgentDeepLinkPrompt
methods.description: Confirms and sends a pending deep link prompt request to the gateway after connection is verified.

methods.name: declinePendingAgentDeepLinkPrompt
methods.description: Cancels a pending deep link prompt and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: presentAgentDeepLinkPrompt
methods.description: Displays a prompt for the user to confirm deep link execution, updating timestamp.

methods.name: queueAgentDeepLinkPrompt
methods.description: Queues a deep link prompt to be delivered after a delay, respecting rate limits.

methods.name: deliverQueuedAgentDeepLinkPrompt
methods.description: Delivers queued prompts respecting rate limits and ongoing prompts, looping until queue is empty.

methods.name: submitAgentDeepLink
methods.description: Sends the agent deep link request to the gateway with error handling.

methods.name: effectiveAgentDeepLinkForPrompt
methods.description: Returns a sanitized version of the deep link with delivery parameters stripped for safety.

methods.name: isUnattendedDeepLinkAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether a deep link key permits unattended execution based on predefined keys.

methods.name: expectedDeepLinkKey
methods.description: Retrieves or generates the persistent deep link key stored in user defaults.

methods.name: generateDeepLinkKey
methods.description: Creates a new secure random deep link key encoded in URL-safe base64 format.
